name: voidsentryultimate-repo
description: Repo tooling for VoidSentryUltimate (docs, benches, packages)

scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate-api && node scripts/sync-moonwave.mjs && npx moonwave build --code tmp/VoidSentryUltimate.docs.luau && node scripts/sync-moonwave.mjs
scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate-api && node scripts/sync-moonwave.mjs && npx moonwave dev --code tmp/VoidSentryUltimate.docs.luau
scripts.docs:dev:watch: npm run docs:generate-api && (node scripts/sync-moonwave.mjs --watch & npx moonwave dev --code tmp/VoidSentryUltimate.docs.luau)
